title.zh: 企业知识库需要怎样的检索、权限和维护
title.en: Retrieval, permissions and maintenance for a company knowledge base

metaDescription.zh: 企业内部知识问答不止于上传文档：详解按员工权限检索、条款级出处定位、转人工工单上下文传递与日常知识维护流程。
metaDescription.en: Why uploading files to a chat window falls short for teams: permission-aware retrieval, clause-level citations, ticket handoffs and ongoing source maintenance.

coverMetric.zh: 权限前置过滤 · 条款级溯源

text.zh: 上传一份文件能应付单次提问；多人长期使用的企业知识库，核心工程在于版本生效控制、检索前权限隔离，以及答不出时的干净转交。
text.en: Uploading a file serves a single prompt. A production company knowledge base depends on active-version control, pre-retrieval permission checks and clean human handoffs.

note.zh: 企业知识库工程设计要点
note.en: Enterprise knowledge system design note

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 01 · 检索前过滤链路

title.zh: 每次提问如何选出合规、有效的制度段落
title.en: How each query selects authorized, active policy clauses

caption.zh: 权限与生效状态在进入生成模型前完成过滤，避免把过期文件或未授权部门资料带入上下文。
caption.en: Role clearance and document validity are enforced before model generation, keeping expired or unauthorized files out of context.

note.zh: 同步账号在职状态与授权目录
note.en: Sync directory clearance before search

note.zh: 保留表格行列关系与条款上下文
note.en: Preserve table structure & clause scope

label.zh: 附带条款出处生成回答

note.zh: 支持一键打开源文档核对
note.en: Open source clause directly for review

note.zh: 日志独立设权，便于排查答错原因
note.en: Separate audit access for root-cause QA

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 02 · 自动分流与人工接手

title.zh: 明确自动回答边界，避免员工向支持人员重复描述
title.en: Clear automation boundaries so employees never repeat context

caption.zh: 当遇到权限提升、制度冲突或资料缺失时，工作流停止猜测并将上下文完整写入工单。
caption.en: When facing elevated privileges, policy conflicts or missing rules, the system stops guessing and writes structured context into the ticket.

label.zh: 常规咨询直接附出处解答

note.zh: 设备申请、VPN 重置、标准排障
note.en: Equipment, VPN reset, documented fixes

label.zh: 识别异常身份或资料冲突
label.en: Detect policy gap or privilege request

note.zh: 不强行生成未经授权的结论
note.en: Halt generation when evidence is incomplete

label.zh: 带上下文自动创建工单

note.zh: 附带已查资料、报错信息与对话记录
note.en: Attach retrieved docs & steps already tried

title.zh: 15 分钟出标书初稿：智能标书系统是怎么搭起来的
title.en: A proposal draft in 15 minutes: how we built it

metaDescription.zh: 拆解智能标书与方案生成工作流：如何把产品知识库、项目约束提取、分章节检索、7 项完整性校验与人工复核结合起来。
metaDescription.en: Inside a production proposal drafting workflow: separating reusable product specs from past project assumptions, staged drafting, 7 completeness checks and human sign-off.

coverMetric.zh: 15 分钟初稿 · 7 项完整性检查

text.zh: 把过去两天的找资料与拼初稿压缩到 15 分钟，前提是不把整本标书交给单次提示词，而是按章节拆分检索、参数计算与完整性核查。
text.en: Cutting two days of assembly down to 15 minutes comes from staged engineering—separating requirement extraction, deterministic parameter checks and section citations rather than relying on one giant prompt.

note.zh: 来自咨询与投研机构标书项目的交付总结
note.en: Lesson from the consulting & research proposal workflow

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 01 · 三类资料分层隔离

title.zh: 把稳定产品知识与旧项目特定假设分开管理
title.en: Separating reusable facts from old project-specific conditions

caption.zh: 避免新方案沿用旧项目的过期报价或特定假设；缺失参数会直接生成缺失信息清单。
caption.en: Prevents stale pricing or prior client assumptions from leaking into a new bid; missing inputs trigger an explicit question list.

note.zh: 绑定设备型号、生效版本与标准参数
note.en: Tied to model version & verified specs

note.zh: 仅复用论证结构与可公开交付记录
note.en: Reuse argument structure, strip old quotes

note.zh: 缺失数值列为问题清单交由业务确认
note.en: Flag missing figures instead of guessing

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 02 · 分阶段生成与 7 项校验

title.zh: 在成稿导出前执行确定性计算与完整性核查
title.en: Deterministic parameter checks and completeness QA before review

caption.zh: 最终承诺、商业条款与专业责任仍由授权审核人员确认，界面支持直接点开每处引用。
caption.en: Commercial commitments and assumptions stay under human review, with one-click access to every underlying citation.

note.zh: 人工先确认大纲方向再展开撰写
note.en: Confirm outline before drafting chapters

label.zh: 分章检索与确定性计算

note.zh: 数值与单位交由确定程序校验
note.en: Units and totals checked programmatically

note.zh: 核查必填章节、资质引用与前后参数一致
note.en: Verify required sections, citations & consistency

label.zh: 人工审阅并导出可编辑稿

note.zh: 审核记录反哺后续模板调优
note.en: Reviewer edits tracked to refine templates

title.zh: 定制、试点还是托管：如何选择合作方式
title.en: Choosing a custom build, pilot or managed AI service

metaDescription.zh: 结合任务频率、资料准备度与内部运维能力，比较完整定制开发、2–6 周低启动试点与托管式 AI 服务的边界与验收方式。
metaDescription.en: How to match workflow frequency, source readiness and internal operating capacity to a full custom build, a 2–6 week pilot or a managed AI service.

coverMetric.zh: 定制 6–12 周 · 试点 2–6 周 · 托管 < 2 周

text.zh: 用自己团队的真实工时、返工率与资料准备成本做测算，远比套用其他企业的回报数字更有决策价值。
text.en: Estimating against your own team’s hours, rework rate and source-preparation effort is far more reliable than borrowing another company’s return figures.

note.zh: 项目启动前的投入产出评估原则
note.en: Pre-project ROI assessment principle

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 01 · 三种合作模式的权责边界

title.zh: 按资产归属、验证阶段与团队精力选择起点
title.en: Matching ownership, validation risk and operating capacity

caption.zh: 如果使用频率尚不确定，先用小范围试点验证真实资料表现，再决定是否扩建完整系统。
caption.en: When usage or source quality is unproven, validate on real documents in a narrow pilot before committing to a full build.

note.zh: 需求明确、高频使用，系统资产归客户所有
note.en: Clear scope & daily usage; client owns system

label.zh: 低启动试点 + 持续服务

note.zh: 单任务快速验证节省工时与采纳度，按结果扩缩
note.en: Test real sources & adoption before scaling

note.zh: 不设内部技术运维，Cyano 运行流程并复核交付
note.en: Cyano runs workflows + QA and delivers batches

eyebrow.zh: 工程图解 02 · 首次 30–45 分钟沟通清单

title.zh: 不需要先写长篇技术需求书，带三样信息即可评估
title.en: No formal spec needed—three inputs are enough to assess fit

caption.zh: 沟通后一周内提供书面评估结论、建议合作模式与停止/验收条件。
caption.en: Within one week of the call, we return a written assessment, recommended model and clear acceptance criteria.

note.zh: 脱敏后的历史标书、制度手册或报表导出样例
note.en: Past proposal, SOP excerpt or sample data export

note.zh: 目前耗时在哪一步、每月处理量与常见返工点
note.en: Where hours go today, monthly volume & rework

label.zh: 业务规则与数据负责人

note.zh: 明确谁解释业务口径、谁开放权限、谁验收结果
note.en: Who defines rules, grants access & signs off
